description: op validate: the Khronos glTF-Validator report of a .glb/.gltf (errors, warnings, the JSON pointer of each). op optimize: gltf-transform dedup, prune and weld, with optional Draco or meshopt compression and meshoptimizer simplification; reports the measured size and triangles before and after and validates the output. A dry run unless write: true, which saves the new file (default <name>.optimized.glb; the input stays) as one undoable step. gltf-validator and @gltf-transform/* (with draco3dgltf, meshoptimizer) are optional packages: when one is missing the answer says what to install.

out.description: optimize: output file, relative to path (default <name>.optimized.glb)

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

simplify.description: optimize: keep about this share of the triangles, e.g. 0.5

write.description: optimize: save the output; default false only reports

name: three_gltf
title: Validate or optimise a glTF model
